    The main, flagship campus of
    Troy University is located in Troy, Alabama. Situated in Pike County, this campus is often referred to as the Troy Campus, located about 50 miles southeast of Montgomery, Alabama. 
    Key Locations: 
    • Main Campus: Troy, Alabama.
    • Other Alabama Campuses: Montgomery, Phenix City, and Dothan. 
    The university is known as Alabama's International University and is situated in a, southern town, according to Troy University and Troy University.
